abstract: The Internet is running out of room - and the problem cannot be solved by simply adding more servers, wires and basestations. Instead, it lies with the number of 'addresses' that the Internet Protocol (IP) can supply in its current form, version 4 (IPv4).

articleTitle: Counting the cost of IT projects
abstract: When I started to write a book on IT cost estimation, friends of mine - all of them seasoned project managers - treated the project with some scepticism.
